title: Audio meter: LUFS, loudness range, true peak
what_it_does: Decodes any audio or video file via ffmpeg and reports integrated LUFS (BS.1770), LRA and true peak, cross-checked against ffmpeg's own ebur128 and failing if they differ by more than 0.5 LU.
when_to_use: Checking the mix of a finished video.
why: Duplicates loudness.py and check.py of ffmpeg-skill; and the file is adapted from anidoodle under Apache-2.0, adding a second licence to carry.
